raw_segments.text: A servant has had the nightmare, that is all. She's an excitable, nervous person. She construed
her dream into an apparition or something of that sort, no doubt, and has taken a fit
with fright. Now, then, I must see you all back into your rooms, for, till the house
is settled, she cannot be looked after. Gentlemen, have the goodness to set the ladies the example.
Miss Ingram, I am sure you will not fail in evincing superiority to idle terrors.
Amy and Louisa return to your nests like a pair of doves, as you are.
Mae Dom, to the Dowagers, you will take cold to a dead certainty if you stay in this chill
